regret_risk: If the design ships as written, the team lives with a seventh mode whose report is invisible to the viewer and reaches design mode only by a paste. A reader may take a recommendation in a report as a checked fact, because the validator checks the form of a confidence tag and not its honesty. The cost is small and reversible: one command file, one reference, one template, and one script.
summary: The design adds /architect:options as a seventh architect mode. It writes one HTML report and proposes alternatives. Design stage 4 still decides, and alone fills intent.alternatives. The invariant it introduces: an architect mode that proposes options never records a decision. Every finding below is a prediction made before the code exists.

findings.title: The mode overlaps the framing that ADR-0013 gives to design mode
findings.detail: ADR-0013 says design mode owns framing, exploration, and the challenge. The options mode frames inquiries before a design exists. The engineer kept the separate mode because it covers the whole system and design mode covers one change.
findings.mitigation: State the scope split in ADR-0035 and in the options-mode reference. Options proposes. Design stage 4 decides.

findings.title: The report is not a record in the lifecycle index
findings.detail: ADR-0018 gives the viewer one lifecycle surface fed by data/index.json. A report under docs/architecture/options/ is not an entity in that index, so the viewer does not show it. The engineer accepted this gap for now.
findings.mitigation: Record the gap as an unknown. A later design can add a build_index.py projection.

findings.title: Inline SVG leaves the shared diagram pipeline
findings.detail: The mermaid skill is vendored into every plugin so that diagrams share one pipeline. The report uses hand-written SVG for emphasis borders and badges, and ships no .mmd copy.
findings.mitigation: ADR-0035 records the exception and the reason.

findings.title: The mode must keep the install surface closed
findings.detail: Only implement may ship an agent or a hook. The options mode adds a command file, a skill section, a reference, a template, and a script. It ships no agent, hook, or MCP server.
findings.mitigation: A test asserts that the architect plugin ships no agent, hook, or MCP server.

findings.title: The validator checks form and not truth
findings.detail: The validator reads the HTML only. It checks anchors, figures, links from rows to directions, confidence values, and external links. It cannot tell whether a Verified tag is honest.
findings.mitigation: State the limit in the options-mode reference. The reviewer reads the evidence section of each report.

boundary_checks.rule: No agents, no hooks, no MCP servers in the architect install surface
boundary_checks.note: The mode is a command file that dispatches the architecture skill, the same shape as the other six.

boundary_checks.rule: Architecture modes are self-only and take no --repo
boundary_checks.note: The mode refuses a foreign target and an output override.

boundary_checks.rule: No plugin script or skill names another plugin's path
boundary_checks.note: The validator lives in plugins/architect/scripts/. The hand-off to design names the mode and not a path.
